newsitem.title: USA: Compaq cuts some computer prices as much as 16 percent.
newsitem.headline: Compaq cuts some computer prices as much as 16 percent.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp., the nation's No. 1 personal computer maker, said Thursday it cut prices on its Armada 1100 line of PCs by as much as 16 percent.
Compaq dropped prices on the Armada 1120 by 13 percent to $1,299, Armada 1120T by 10 percent to $1,799, Armada 1130 by 16 percent to $1,599 and Armada 1130T by 13 percent to $1,999.
It also set a promotion for a SpeedPaq 288 Data/Fax Modem bundled with the purchase of a Compaq Armada 1120 or 1120T notebook PC.
Compaq stock was up $1.625 at $78.625 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
